proposition: Ibn Turka's son Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad wrote two letters, before 867/1463, to the governor of Isfahan Amīr Muḥammad Shāh (brother of Fīrūzshāh) and to a bureaucrat, about finishing his education: sent from Herat to Shiraz, he feared he would never complete his studies if he returned to Herat.

mediation.note: A student's petition, decades after Ibn Turka's death.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK notes Jamāl al-Dīn may be another Turka's son
